## indie's Combined SoC and Perception Software for Advanced DMS/OMS Awarded In-Cabin Solution of the Year


October 19, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/900030961/files/doc_news/indies-Combined-SoC-and-Perception-Software-for-Advanced-DMSOMS-Awarded-In-Cabin-Solution-of-the-Year-2026.pdf)


*Annual Awards Program Recognizes Breakthrough Innovation in Automotive & Transportation Technologies Around the Globe*


ALISO VIEJO, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


indie Semiconductor (Nasdaq: INDI), an automotive solutions innovator, today announced it has been awarded “In-Cabin Solution of the Year” by AutoTech Breakthrough, a leading market intelligence organization that recognizes the top companies, technologies and products in the global automotive and transportation markets.


indie's Combined SoC and Perception Software for Advanced DMS/OMS Awarded In-Cabin Solution of the Year


indie’s combined driver and occupant monitoring system (DMS/OMS) in-cabin platform is a pre-integrated pairing of the company’s next-generation Edge AI SoC,[iND881](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.indie.inc%2Fproduct%2Find881%2F&esheet=54622367&newsitemid=20261015802029&lan=en-US&anchor=iND881&index=1&md5=05e603458ecba53622ac21862f3b9da5) , with its emotion3D[in-cabin perception](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.indie.inc%2Fperception-software%2F&esheet=54622367&newsitemid=20261015802029&lan=en-US&anchor=in-cabin+perception&index=2&md5=934a6ad6d91247eaeb1cb8522a68c47f) stack. The platform can be deployed as a fully pre-integrated hardware–software package with the iND881, or used independently as a standalone perception software offering, providing greater flexibility to meet customer architectural requirements. This integrated approach helps significantly reduce third-party IP complexity and development risk through hardware co-design, with no hidden incompatibilities.


By offering hardware and software through a single vendor, customers benefit from one team and contract spanning proof-of-concept through series production. Both the iND881 and emotion3D software are also available independently, giving customers the flexibility to work on their existing hardware or software partners.


“We are honored to have our perception software and hardware recognized by AutoTech Breakthrough. This award validates our capability of combining hardware and software and delivering performance reliability and accelerated deployment to our customers at an attractive price point,” said Florian Seitner, vice president and general manager, perception software at indie. “As in-cabin sensing requirements grow more stringent under evolving safety regulations and driven by consumer expectations, having a single partner with a proven track record of delivering systems into series production is a significant advantage.”


“indie’s unique platform eliminates third-party IP complexity and removes the risk of undiscovered incompatibilities. Historically, automakers and Tier 1 suppliers have faced a fragmented sourcing model: hardware and software from individual vendors that leads to integration chaos. When something breaks in production, accountability ping-pongs between vendors. Costly late-stage incompatibilities delay launches,” said Bryan Vaughn, Managing Director, AutoTech Breakthrough. “Beyond simply introducing a new sensing feature, indie delivers a structural shift in how in-cabin systems can be sourced, integrated, and brought to market. In the end, customers benefit from a more predictable, lower-risk path from concept to production. We’re excited to award indie with ‘In-Cabin Solution of the Year.’”


**About indie**


Headquartered in Aliso Viejo, CA, indie is accelerating ADAS intelligence across automotive, quantum, and Physical AI applications through next-generation hardware, system solutions, and perception software technologies. By developing high-performance, energy-efficient semiconductor, photonic, and software solutions, we are enabling machines to perceive, understand, and interact with the physical world. Spanning radar, computer vision, LiDAR, and ultrasound, our platforms power advanced safety, automation, positioning, and automated capabilities for leading automotive OEMs, intelligent machines, and emerging AI-driven systems worldwide.
